summary: Restore replication worker admission when Linux service-manager ancestry is unreadable

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Replication and consistency rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: When local harness ancestry is unavailable, the supervised replication worker receives the same admission as a verified person caller. This requires the socket connector's live process generation to match the supervisor's worker PID, independently of the worker ingress observe/enforce mode. Other unverifiable callers remain refused on internal routes and person-header requests, including both accepted person-header spellings.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
